articles.title: Mystery solved? Why ‘sleeping’ ants suddenly explode with activity
articles.snippet: For decades, scientists have puzzled over what triggers some colonies of ants to burst from rest into community-wide action. Math may now explain this.
articles.summary: Scientists used math to solve a decades-old mystery about what causes resting ant colonies to suddenly become very active. This new research explains why these sleeping ants burst into community-wide action.

articles.title: Static electricity remains shockingly mysterious
articles.snippet: Despite studying static charge for centuries, scientists still aren’t clear on precisely how it works.
articles.summary: Scientists have been studying static charge for hundreds of years. However, they still do not know exactly how it works.

articles.title: Analyze This: Microbes can make valuable chemicals more sustainably
articles.snippet: Food waste-fed bacteria may someday make chemical ingredients for medicines, cosmetics and more.
articles.summary: Scientists are studying how bacteria fed with food waste could one day create chemical ingredients for medicines and cosmetics. This process might help make valuable chemicals more sustainably in the future.
